correctness.rationale: For all geometric critical points, the exact mod-five derivative equations reduce to a shared quadratic in nonzero fourth powers. Support count 1 or 2 is impossible, support 3 gives 64 points, and support 4 forces all fourth powers equal with a product-of-squares condition, giving 32 points. The two orbits have nonsingular 3-by-3 affine Hessians of determinant 3 modulo five, hence 96 reduced A1 singularities. The point count follows separately over F5. Finite singular support forces geometric irreducibility and Serre R1/S2 yields normality. CHECK.py was executed and its exact finite identities and Hessian matrices matched the proof.

value.rationale: A celebrated highly symmetric smooth complex octic degenerates at a natural bad prime to a normal integral octic with an unexpectedly large, completely split set of 96 ordinary nodes; all its F5 points are singular. The exact complete singularity scheme and arithmetic rationality are natural invariants relevant to arithmetic degeneration and monodromy questions. This is not a random parameter slice or an enumeration presented without geometric proof.
